basic_profile.bio: I'm a strategic gaming enthusiast based in Minneapolis. I work as a software developer by day, and by night, I'm a dedicated gamer, diving deep into RTS games like Iron Harvest and Company of Heroes. My interests also extend to visual novels, with a particular fondness for 'Umineko'. I'm single and enjoy spending my evenings and weekends exploring new gaming strategies or engaging in discussions on Reddit. My typical online hours are from 7 PM to midnight on weekdays and more flexibly during the weekends.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: I hold a degree in Computer Science from the University of Minnesota, which has significantly contributed to my analytical skills in gaming. My passion for strategy games began in high school and has been honed through years of dedicated play and community interaction.
